# Wheeler Lawn & Landscaping, L.C.

> Sprinkler repair, winterization, and spring start-up for Lee's Summit, MO and the eastern Kansas City metro. Owner-run crew. Phone/text: (816) 213-5011.

This is a prototype site built as a sample by Clarion Studio and is not yet the business's official site. Facts marked [confirm] are placeholders pending the owner's input.

## Services
- Sprinkler Repair (/services/sprinkler-repair.html): head, valve, wiring, and mainline repair for existing irrigation systems.
- Winterization (/services/winterization.html): compressed-air blow-out before the first hard freeze, typically mid-to-late October in this region.
- Spring Start-Up (/services/spring-startup.html): pressure test, zone walk, backflow check, and head adjustment, typically early-to-mid April.

## Service area
Lee's Summit, MO, Blue Springs, MO, Raytown, MO, Independence, MO, Grain Valley, MO. See /service-area.html for the full list.
